newsitem.title: USA: LPC-Three banks back Northwest with $650 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: LPC-Three banks back Northwest with $650 mln loan.

text.p: NEW YORK, Oct 9 (LPC) - Northwest Airlines has tapped Bankers Trust New York Corp, Chase Manhattan Corp and Citicorp's Citibank for a $650 million bank loan, banking sources said.
The bank loan represents reduced pricing compared with a loan established in December 1995, banking sources added.
The five-year loan is split between a $500 million revolver and a $150 million term loan.
Pricing starts at 100 basis points over the London Inter-Bank Offered Rate (LIBOR), with a 22.5-basis-point fee on undrawn amounts, a banker said.
Pricing on last year's deal started at LIBOR plus 125 basis points, with a 32.5-basis-point undrawn fee, sources said.
